meta.title: Day 4 of 5: The Break Room Goes Dark
meta.summary: Floor 1 timed playthrough, Day 4 of 5: the Break Room and every vendor lose service, the terminal key is gone, and the Green Room is the only honest saferoom. Three routes, four encounters, key availability, early-descent handling, rest options with the rest-without-saferoom slot, last-chance hooks and a stall fallback. CR, budget, credit and loot figures are cited from rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json by field path (GM-adaptable guideline). Collapse notices use Lore's draft wording; the final collapse is fixed and a missed collapse is death on every floor, with no Reprieve.

clock.zone_groups: Confirmed (decision 026, tagged inspired): outer zones (Z0 to Z4 plus 3b) close Day 2; mid zones (Z5, Z7 and Z8) close Day 3; on Day 4 the Break Room (Z6) and vendors lose service; on Day 5 only the corridor (Z10, Z11 and Z S) remains. The Z9 Green Room saferoom stays open to the end (inspired). Closed means hooks and services vanish; the route (Z6, Z8, Z9, Z10, Z11) is never cut.
clock.stairwell_opens: About 32 hours after the floor opens, early Day 2 (canon M-276, VERIFIED). The Z10 boss arena also holds a stairwell (canon M-275). The Stairwell key and the Zone S door are house ideas, tagged inspired.
clock.early_descent: A Crawler who descends with more than 6 hours left on the floor is held in stasis until the floor collapses (canon M-277, VERIFIED): this banks the achievement and ends that Crawler's floor. In the last 6 hours, descent is free. Each Crawler chooses for themselves; the GM may override with a logged reason.
clock.collapse_order_status: confirmed per decision 026; the steps only remove hooks and services, and the Detour Tax is the only toll on the clock (a missed Stairwell key only)

final_collapse.status: Syndicate default, decision 026; Caleb may veto
final_collapse.text: The final collapse comes at a FIXED moment: 24 in-game hours into Day 5 (hour 120 of the floor). A Long Rest never ends the floor and never skips it; the System cuts short any rest that would run past the collapse.

collapse_miss.tag: canon-aligned (canon: a missed collapse ends the run)
collapse_miss.text: Any Crawler not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, and all Crawlers still on the floor die with it. There is no Reprieve, no toll and no detour for it. Death rules follow Core section 6 (death is pretty much game over). Per decision 028 (tagged inspired): the dead Crawler's credits and items are destroyed with the floor; surviving party members may loot the body only while the floor still stands, and anything taken before the collapse is theirs. NPCs and the AI go into stasis and lose nothing.
collapse_miss.stasis_counts: Early-descent stasis (canon M-277) counts as reaching a stairwell.
collapse_miss.detour_tax_scope: The Detour Tax now covers only a missed Stairwell key, never a missed collapse.

saferoom_rule.text: The Break Room (Z6) is a saferoom through Day 3 and stops being one when it loses service on Day 4 (Syndicate ruling, decision 026). From then on the Z9 Green Room is the only saferoom, open to the end of the floor (tagged inspired).

clock.achievement_caps: Floor caps still apply: the soft cap is 2 to 3 achievement boxes per Crawler per floor (Caleb's ruling); on Floors 1 and 2 the Silver ceiling and one Story Box per floor hold. Rewards are tailored by the GM and snark-only is allowed; the proposed achievements are a seed list at GM discretion.

day.stall_fallback: If the party stalls, the Lights-Out hour arrives, the countdown ticks, and the System offers a Long Rest at the Green Room. A party with no key yet can still pay the toll, use tools or force the door, or take the boss route. Do not steer anyone toward early descent. lines.text: The lights go out in sections, one hall at a time, until only your own lantern is left. The dark makes a sound, a slow settling, like a building thinking.
You find a dead-end alcove and sit with your backs to the wall. Every few minutes the far end of the hall clicks, ticks, and goes quiet again.
Someone has left a half-eaten ration and a note on the floor: "Slept here. Do not recommend." No signature.
Rest is possible, but it is not comfortable. Whoever takes watch hears the System's announcement chime from three zones away, muffled, like a door closing on a party you were not invited to.
